title: method_final_v2 -- unified format-aware cascade + Pareto knob, with F8 (certified weak-veto, accuracy-max MCQ/PMC) and F10 (team-objective L2D, shared open arm) folded in. All numbers recomputed live from per-sample dumps + measured cost constants + held-out (5-fold) calibration.

F8_certified_weak_veto.replaces: the accuracy-max MCQ/PMC F3 confidence-advantage fusion cell
F8_certified_weak_veto.mechanic: beat32b_more.f8_veto: per (dataset x TRAIN 7B-conf quantile-bin), VETO the 32B (keep 7B) iff Wilson-LB(7B precision) >= 32B accuracy on TRAIN; else take 32B. One-sided => never-worse. Cross-fit 5-fold; veto cells are 7B-only (skip the 32B) => cheaper than fusion.
F8_certified_weak_veto.effect: captures most of F3's PMC beat at a fraction of the FLOPs -> accuracy-max goes FLOP-NEGATIVE.

F10_team_objective_L2D.replaces: the open-text arm's parity-targeting tau escalation gate (shared by both modes)
F10_team_objective_L2D.mechanic: beat32b_more.f10_l2d: learned logistic rejector over 7B-side open-text features (verifier score max/range/mean/std, #unique preds, self-consistency, seqlogprob); threshold tuned on TRAIN to maximise TEAM accuracy; cross-fit 5-fold. Decides escalate-to-32B vs keep-7B-best-of-N. Pandora adaptive-N still sets the cheap draw count (meanN) for the cost model.
F10_team_objective_L2D.effect: repairs the two residual open losses (SLAKE_open, VQA_RAD_open) and lifts PathVQA_open; the parity-tau gate targeted iso-32B by design, so it sat at/below 32B on those cells.

accuracy_max_flop_negative.note: F8 swaps the F3 fusion (both legs on 100% of PMC = 5.57 FLOP) for the certified veto (7B on all + 32B only on the 60% non-veto cells = 3.74 FLOP), cutting the accuracy-max full-suite FLOPs 5.695 -> 4.246 (1.25x -> 0.93x always-32B) and flipping the arm FLOP-NEGATIVE, while retaining 70% of F3's PMC beat over 32B and still CI-certified above it.

headline.compute_lean_v2: +0.0123 vs always-32B-THINK / +0.0023 vs always-32B-NO-THINK @ 2.238 FLOP-eq (0.49x always-32B), lat_seq 577 ms / lat_par 468 ms  [margin-cascade MCQ + F10 open]
headline.accuracy_max_v2: +0.0212 vs always-32B-THINK / +0.0112 vs always-32B-NO-THINK @ 4.246 FLOP-eq (0.93x always-32B = FLOP-NEGATIVE), lat_par 729 ms  [F8-veto PMC + F10 open; was 1.25x with F3]

data_gaps: F8 captures MOST (not all) of F3's PMC beat: the accuracy-max PMC cell d_vs_nothink drops +0.0135 (F3) -> +0.0095 (F8) but stays CI-certified above 32B; the trade buys the FLOP-negative arm.

F10 open arm bills the cheap leg at Pandora's adaptive meanN(<8) draws while scoring the KEEP leg on the best-of-8 verifier pick -> the kept-7B accuracy is mildly optimistic vs a strict best-of-meanN; the escalation set + delivered accuracy come from the held-out F10 rejector.
F10 routes on 7B-side features only (open-text dumps have no 32B prediction TEXT, only judge_ok) -> no cross-model-agreement feature; still fully OFFLINE.
32B-THINK open-text accuracy is ESTIMATED (judged 32B-no-think + measured modal think-delta -0.195/-0.120/-0.130); PathVQA-closed has no 32B-think dump -> think acc = no-think.
SLAKE/VQA-RAD/PathVQA-open are IN-DOMAIN for the pooled4 verifier (trained on those families).
